INTRO_KR: Yogaholic Studio is a social enterprise dedicated to supporting children with Special Educational Needs and their parents. For children, our program, Embrace Angel Yogis, integrates storybooks and yoga practices with mindfulness techniques. This approach aims to improve sensory integration and enhance focus, emotional regulation, and social skills, helping children better engage with the world around them. For parents, our Mindful Parenting Learning Group uses mindfulness as a foundation, allowing parents to learn and experience a different approach to parenting, ultimately improving their relationships with their children. At Yogaholic Studio, we believe in the potential of every child. By combining yoga, storytelling, and mindfulness, we aim to create an inclusive space where children with SEN can thrive, and where parents feel supported and empowered. Our ultimate goal is to promote understanding, acceptance, and joy within families, enabling them to navigate the unique challenges they face together. Through our dedicated programs, Yogaholic Studio is committed to transforming the lives of children and their families, fostering a brighter future for all.
